description: Summary figure: the four discriminating axes (burial, bundle geometry, Sec61 insertion energy, family-wide reproducibility), all plotted from the computed provenance tables
code:
import json, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

sb  = pd.read_csv("segment_benchmark.csv")
geo = pd.read_csv("segment_geometry.csv")
dg  = json.load(open("dgpred_results.json"))
ph  = pd.read_csv("phobius_family_sample.csv")

COL = {"ahk1":"#d6336c","membrane":"#1c7ed6","soluble":"#868e96"}
LAB = {"ahk1":"ahk1 segments\n(n=3)","membrane":"real TM helices\n(6 polytopic, n=18)","soluble":"soluble cores\n(6 cytosolic, n=18)"}
order = ["ahk1","membrane","soluble"]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 4, figsize=(19, 4.8))

for i,c in enumerate(order):
    v = sb[sb.cls==c].mean_rsa.values
    ax[0].scatter(np.full(len(v), i)+np.linspace(-.13,.13,len(v)), v, s=46, color=COL[c], zorder=3, edgecolor="w", lw=.6)
    ax[0].hlines(v.mean(), i-.26, i+.26, color=COL[c], lw=2.6, zorder=4)
ax[0].set_xticks(range(3)); ax[0].set_xticklabels([LAB[c] for c in order], fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_ylabel("mean relative solvent accessibility")
ax[0].set_title("a  Burial in the AlphaFold model\nahk1 vs real TM: U=6, p=0.017", fontsize=9.5)
ax[0].grid(axis="y", alpha=.25)

for i,c in enumerate(order):
    v = geo[geo.cls==c].mean_pair_angle.values
    ax[1].scatter(np.full(len(v), i)+np.linspace(-.13,.13,len(v)), v, s=46, color=COL[c], zorder=3, edgecolor="w", lw=.6)
    if len(v)>1: ax[1].hlines(v.mean(), i-.26, i+.26, color=COL[c], lw=2.6, zorder=4)
ax[1].set_xticks(range(3)); ax[1].set_xticklabels([LAB[c] for c in order], fontsize=8)
ax[1].set_ylabel("mean pairwise helix-axis angle (deg)")
ax[1].set_title("b  Bundle geometry\nahk1 56.1 deg, z = +2.26 vs membrane", fontsize=9.5)
ax[1].grid(axis="y", alpha=.25)

keys = ["pma1 TM3","trk1 TM3","ahk1 277-297","ahk1 400-420","pkd2 TM2","ahk1 374-394","ScAhk1 123-143","S.cryo 254-274"]
vals = [dg[k] for k in keys]
cols = ["#d6336c" if k.startswith("ahk1") else ("#1c7ed6" if "TM" in k else "#f08c00") for k in keys]
ax[2].barh(range(len(keys)), vals, color=cols)
ax[2].set_yticks(range(len(keys))); ax[2].set_yticklabels(keys, fontsize=8); ax[2].invert_yaxis()
ax[2].axvline(0, color="k", lw=1)
ax[2].set_xlabel("dgpred insertion free energy (kcal/mol)")
ax[2].set_title("c  Sec61 insertion energy\nnegative inserts; pkd2 TM2 is the caveat", fontsize=9.5)
ax[2].grid(axis="x", alpha=.25)

cnt = ph.nTM.value_counts().reindex([0,1,2,3]).fillna(0).astype(int)
bars = ax[3].bar([str(i) for i in cnt.index], cnt.values, color=["#868e96","#868e96","#868e96","#d6336c"])
for b,v in zip(bars, cnt.values):
    if v: ax[3].text(b.get_x()+b.get_width()/2, v+.8, str(v), ha="center", fontsize=9)
ax[3].text(0.97, 0.72, "8/8 named orthologs: 0 TM\n(S. cryophilus, S. cerevisiae Ahk1,\n2x Lachancea, Zygosaccharomyces,\nEremothecium, S. arboricola, C. glabrata)",
           transform=ax[3].transAxes, ha="right", fontsize=7.6,
           bbox=dict(boxstyle="round,pad=0.45", fc="#f1f3f5", ec="#adb5bd"))
ax[3].annotate("O14260", xy=(3, cnt.loc[3]), xytext=(2.3, 13), fontsize=9, color="#d6336c",
               arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color="#d6336c"))
ax[3].set_xlabel("Phobius TM helices predicted")
ax[3].set_ylabel("PF08578 proteins (n=53)")
ax[3].set_title("d  Family-wide reproducibility\nahk1 is 1 of 53 with 3 TM", fontsize=9.5)
ax[3].grid(axis="y", alpha=.25)

fig.suptitle("S. pombe ahk1 (O14260): the three predicted transmembrane helices behave as the buried core of a soluble fold",
             fontsize=11.5, y=1.015)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
